CVE-2026-56855.9900413b43fd6653d2a101e8afa8e3f088cdbfa7:
security: bump dependencies (#38705)

* security: bump golang.org/x/crypto to v0.56.0

Fixes two DoS vulnerabilities in the SSH package. The vulnerable
package golang.org/x/crypto/ssh is not directly imported by
mattermost; the module is pulled in transitively via other x/crypto
subpackages so the affected functions are not reachable at runtime,
but bumping keeps the dependency clean of known advisories.

- CVE-2026-56855 / GO-2026-6355: DoS on deadlocked established channel
- CVE-2026-78662 / GO-2026-6354: DoS on deadlocked undecided channel

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* security: bump google.golang.org/grpc to v1.83.2

Fixes a DoS panic in the xDS server routing interceptor when a request
is received without both the :authority and Host headers. Mattermost
imports grpc only transitively and does not construct servers via
xds.NewGRPCServer, so the vulnerable code path is unreachable in the
Mattermost binary, but the transitive dependency is bumped to keep
the module clean of known advisories.

- CVE-2026-84445 / GHSA-2v4p-qf9q-27wj / GO-2026-6443

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* security: bump x/crypto to v0.57.0 and grpc to v1.84.0

Roll both dependencies forward from the initial minimum-fix versions
(v0.56.0 and v1.83.2) to the current latest stable releases, picking
up all interim fixes at once so the scanner does not re-open these
rows on the next patch cycle.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
